title: Plus One Linked List
goal: Solve Plus One Linked List: Propagate a one-digit increment through the linked number, turning trailing nines into zeros and extending the head only when necessary.
strategy: Propagate a one-digit increment through the linked number, turning trailing nines into zeros and extending the head only when necessary.
edgeCases: An all-nine number creates a new leading one; a non-nine suffix stops the carry.
